note: What every ingested document is read for, per domain. A document is not one kind of thing: an FM contract names a vendor, the assets it covers, the PPM frequency it commits to and the certificates it requires — four domains in one file. The pipeline used to pick ONE winner from the filename and run ONE extractor, so three of those four were never read. Every domain here is tested against every document, and a domain that is absent is recorded as absent WITH THE REASON rather than silently skipped. `lands` names the real column a field is destined for, so a rule that points nowhere is visible as a bug instead of quietly extracting into nothing.

confidence.note: At or above accept, a fact may be written. Between review and accept it becomes a draft for a person. Below review it is reported and discarded — a low-confidence figure written into a domain table is indistinguishable from a measured one once it is a row.
